My name is Bart Konings. I am 37 years old, born and raised in Eindhoven, the Netherlands.

In 2019, I started a serious e-commerce dropshipping business and, through ups and downs, managed to grow it into a successful company.



I am currently looking for someone to join my team. To start, you will be responsible for listing products on our websites. If the collaboration works well, there will be opportunities to grow within the company and take on additional responsibilities. 



The education you've completed or your background doesn't really matter to me. Experience with Shopify, marketing, and creating images with AI would be nice, but it's definitely not required. I can teach you all of that. One thing I would like to know, though: what is your favorite color? include this in a message, not in the video.



What is important to me is that you're intelligent, can work independently, and that when I explain something, you actually follow the instructions. I value people who work carefully and professionally rather than being sloppy. Good English communication skills are also important.



I’m looking for someone who is motivated and driven—someone who can complete work both quickly and accurately.

If you're unsure whether you meet the requirements above, please do not apply.



That may sound harsh, but I already have several people who have been working with me for years, and they are genuinely great people to work with. I have a very good relationship with my team, there is a positive atmosphere, and I have a lot of respect and appreciation for the people I work with.



At the same time, I have also had to let several people go over the years. That's why I want to be very clear upfront—simply in the hope of attracting the right people and avoiding the wrong fit.



Do you recognize yourself in this description? Then please record a short video introducing yourself. 

In the video, please answer the following questions:



What is your age?



How many hours can you work per week?



Do you have experience with Shopify, marketing, and creating images with AI?



It's not that important but would be nice. If you do not have experience just say; no honestly.

COMPENSATION

Base Pay - $1,500 – $2,000 / month USD

KPI bonus - $500 – $667 / month USD

OTE - $2,000 – $2,667 / month USD



The Role

Four platforms. 87 creators by 2027. Thousands of posts a month across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, and
 — every one of them on schedule, on-brief, and inside the lines on platforms that change the lines without warning.



That's the operation. We're hiring the person who runs it.



You'll report directly to the CPO. You'll manage three department heads on day one, four by month two. You'll be the final compliance authority on every piece of content that goes out the door — the person whose judgment d
 what ships and what doesn't when the rulebook runs out. You'll build the YouTube and
 departments from nothing, while the Meta/TikTok and Reddit teams keep posting at full volume underneath you.



We're a creator management agency operating in an adult-adjacent niche, growing 4× in 18 months. This seat doesn't exist at most companies because most companies don't operate at this volume on this many platforms simultaneously. We do. We need someone who's done it before — or who's hungry enough to do it bigger than they ever have.



The Scope

- 4 platform departments: Meta/TikTok (live, ~12 people), Reddit (live, 5 people), YouTube (you'll build it starting June, 3 people),
 (you'll build it from August, 4 people)

- Direct reports: 3 department heads on day one, 4 by month two

- Reporting line: directly to the Chief Product Officer

- Headcount trajectory: 17 ? 30+ within your first six months



What You'll Be Measured On

- Posting volume hit rate, per platform, per creator

- Violation rate trend (down, week on week)

- Engagement-to-subscriber growth across the portfolio

- Hire quality and ramp time for the YouTube and
 departments



The Candidate We Want

- 5+ years running social media operations across multiple platforms simultaneously, with a clear track record of growing reach, engagement, and revenue

- Experience managing managers. This role is two layers up from the posting floor.

- Strong TOS and enforcement-pattern knowledge across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Reddit. You'll be the final compliance gatekeeper.

- You've stood up a platform team from scratch before, or scaled one through a major step change

- You're system-minded: you fix root causes, not symptoms, and you build feedback loops between teams

- AI-fluent in your daily workflow

- Professionally comfortable with adult-adjacent creator content — neither squeamish nor cavalier



Location & Hours

We're hiring in South Africa and the Philippines. 100% remote. Daily working hours start at 7:00am SAST (South Africa) or align with GMT+8 (Philippines) for team overlap. Strong global candidates considered where overlap is equivalent or better.

description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.

Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. • Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers

description:
Hi everyone! We are a growing e-commerce company, and we are looking for a talented, fast, and highly driven Full-Time AI Video Editor to join our team 40 hours/week (5 days/week).



This is not a traditional video editing role. We are looking for someone who masterfully leverages modern AI video tools to produce high-converting video ads at scale.



What you’ll do:

Create 100% AI-generated video ads: Turn scripts, hooks, and creative briefs into high-quality, high-converting vertical video ads (9:16, 30-75 seconds).



Master AI B-Rolls: You must be exceptional at generating hyper-realistic or highly engaging AI B-rolls (using tools like Sora, Kling, Runway Gen-3, Luma, etc.) to illustrate the voiceovers perfectly.

Proven experience in AI Video Generation: You know how to prompt AI video models to get exactly the visual you want, especially for B-rolls. This is a mandatory requirement.



Resourcefulness & Creativity: We provide the brief, but you bring the video to life. You know how to take initiative and surprise us with your edits.



Efficiency & Speed: You can maintain a consistent, high-volume daily output independently. Speed and reliability matter a lot to us.



The ads are primarily targeted at French-speaking markets. You don’t need to be a native French speaker, but you must be able to deliver flawless, natural-looking French text-on-screen and voiceover synchronization.



Tools:

We provide access to top-tier AI generation and localization tools (like ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, and others) - (Kling, Runway, Sora, etc.)



You must have your own subscriptions for CapCut Pro and ChatGPT/Claude.



What we offer:

Salary: $1,500 / month.



Type: Full-time (40h/week, 5 days/week).



Bonuses: We take care of the people who perform. Solid bonuses and gifts will be unlocked when your videos hit great performance metrics.



Growth: Work with a team that moves fast and uses cutting-edge technology.



How to apply & Process:

If you're interested, send over your portfolio / examples of AI videos you have created in the past (especially showcasing your AI B-roll generation skills and Meta Adds Creatives).



Note on our selection process: We will review all portfolios and select the top 10 profiles. Those selected will be asked to do a paid creative test ($30 for a well-made 30s video) based on a brief for one of our brands. We filter out low-effort or rushed work, but we value and pay for real effort.



Show us you're the most motivated and creative editor in the room. Looking forward to seeing your work!

---



## About the Role



We are a Snowflake-native data infrastructure platform serving wealth management firms including RIAs, broker-dealers, family offices, and TAMPs. We are building a world-class revenue team and looking for a Sales Development Support Specialist to provide critical operational leverage to our US-based sales organization.



This role powers the sales development and account executive team by handling the research-intensive and repetitive elements of prospecting and outreach. You will use AI-assisted workflows — specifically Claude — to generate high-quality prospect lists, craft personalized outreach sequences, and prepare meeting materials so that our frontline sellers can focus on live conversations and closing.



This is not a traditional SDR role. You will not be making cold calls or running discovery meetings. You are the engine behind the team's outbound motion — the person who makes every rep more effective by delivering better data, sharper messaging, and more qualified opportunities.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### Prospect Research & List Building



- Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, industry databases, conference attendee lists, and web research.

- Enrich prospect records with firmographic data (AUM, custodian, tech stack, advisor headcount) and technographic signals.

- Maintain clean, segmented prospect lists across territories with no overlap or duplication between sales tea
mbers.

- Monitor intent signals including job changes, company news, M&A activity, funding rounds, and technology announcements that create timely outreach opportunities.



### Outreach & Sequence Management



- Draft personalized outreach sequences 
 and LinkedIn) using Claude, tailored to each prospect's firm type, tech stack, and likely pain points.

- Create multiple message variants for A/B testing across subject lines, value propositions, and calls to action.

- Manage HubSpot sequences and ensure cadences are running on schedule, follow-ups are triggered, and responses are routed to the appropriate sales tea
mber.

- Track and report outreach performance metrics weekly: open rates, reply rates, meeting conversion rates, and sequence effectiveness.



### Meeting Preparation & Post-Meeting Support



- Research prospects before every scheduled meeting and prepare one-page briefing documents including company overview, decision-maker profiles, current technology stack, competitive landscape, and potential pain points.

- Summarize call recordings using Claude, extract key action items, and update HubSpot records with accurate meeting notes.

- Ensure all follow-up tasks fro
etings are logged, assigned, and tracked to completion.



### CRM & Data Management



- Maintain accurate and complete prospect and opportunity records in HubSpot.

- Ensure every touchpoint,
, and meeting is logged and attributed correctly.

- Flag data quality issues and proactively clean records on a recurring basis.



---

- Excellent written English with the ability to write natural, conversational, and professional outreach copy that does not read as templated or automated.

- Demonstrated proficiency with Claude or similar AI tools for content generation, research synthesis, and data enrichment. AI-assisted execution is a core expectation of this role, not a bonus skill.

- Experience with HubSpot or comparable CRM and
 sequencing platforms.

- High attention to detail and the ability to manage large datasets accurately without supervision.

- Self-directed work style with the ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and communicate proactively across time zones.



---

- Experience prospecting into B2B SaaS or financial technology companies.

- Understanding of the RIA, broker-dealer, TAMP, or wealth management technology landscape.

- Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator for advanced prospecting and lead filtering.

title: B2C Growth & Events Coordinator, Operations VA
description:
About Free Money Meister

Free Money Meister is an AI-powered scholarship matching and prioritization platform. We help students find the right scholarships, rank them by their actual likelihood of winning, and execute on them. To date our students have won over $500,000 in scholarships, averaging roughly $12,500 per student.



We are a fast-moving, high-bar team. We are building something that matters, and we move quickly. The person in this role works alongside a small group of people who consistently go above and beyond, and we are looking for someone who operates the same way.



The Role

This is a student-facing growth role focused on our B2C segment, getting more students onto the platform. You will own the work of getting Free Money Meister in front of students and families: finding and booking the right marketing events, coordinating our presence at them, and supporting the campaigns and platform work that turn interest into sign-ups. You will report into our operations function and work closely with our Executive Assistant.



This is a part-time, hourly, remote position. We expect roughly 10 hours per week to start, with potential to grow as you prove yourself and as the company scales. Provide your proposed hourly rate.



What You Will Actually Do

• Find, schedule, and coordinate marketing events that put us in front of students and families: college-readiness fairs, school and community events, and similar opportunities across Maryland and the Greater Washington and Greater Baltimore areas.

• Book and coordinate our own sessions, such as Scholarship 101 workshops, with schools, organizations, and event hosts.

• Run the outbound pipeline work to get students onto the platform: identifying the right events and hosts, reaching out, and following through to a confirmed booking.

• Support inbound growth: helping the platform get discovered by students searching online and through AI tools, and tracking those efforts.

• Help oversee and track platform changes and improvements that keep the student experience up to par as we grow.

• Provide general marketing support: building and maintaining the events calendar, organizing assets, light campaign execution, and capturing what is needed for sign-ups and registrations accurately.



Who We Are Looking For

Experience is helpful but not required. We care far more about how you work than where you have worked. The right person is:

• Super responsive. You reply quickly and you communicate proactively. If you are blocked or unsure, we hear from you while you are working, not after.

• An overachiever. You go above and beyond. You notice things we did not ask about and surface them. You treat our goals as your goals.

• A strong independent thinker. You can take an ambiguous task, make a judgment call, and defend your reasoning. You do not just execute, you think.

• A clear communicator. Much of this role is reaching out to schools, event organizers, and hosts on our behalf, so clear, professional written communication matters.

• Efficient and honest about time. You use modern tools, including AI, to move fast. Your logged time reflects the actual scope of the work.

• A culture fit. You thrive on a small team that holds a high bar and moves fast. You take direction well and self-correct quickly.



Tools and AI

We expect you to use AI tools to work efficiently, and we view that as a strength, not something to hide. What we are evaluating is the judgment you add on top of the tools: the thinking, the prioritization, and the decisions. AI can build a list. It cannot d
 which events are worth our time or why. That part is you.



A Note Before You Apply

You do not have to be an expert in this field. What we are looking for is someone who is smart, has grit and initiative, and goes above and beyond. If that is you, there is a quick accompanying gig included with this posting that we would like you to complete and send over together with your job application. It helps us assess you better.



Applications that include the completed gig will get our attention. The gig is your chance to show us who you are.



Gig

We want to get Free Money Meister in front of students and families by showing up at the right events. Your task: research and build a list of the top 10 to 20 marketing events we should target for Fall 2026 through Spring 2027 in Maryland, the Greater Washington (DC) area, and/or the Greater Baltimore area.



Think about events where college-bound students and their families actually show up, for example: college and college-readiness fairs, financial aid and FAFSA nights, scholarship workshops, high school college nights, community and education expos, and similar gatherings. Choose the events you believe give us the highest-value opportunity to reach students and get them onto the platform.



For each event, capture what matters and explain your thinking. Describe your process and why you made the choices that you made. The formatting is totally up to you.



Note: If you want to make an impact, be part of fast growth, and work with a team that's all willing to put in the work, then this is the right place for you.



How We Hire

Resumes tell us very little about how someone actually works. So our process centers on the accompanying gig, which mirrors the real work of this role and lets us see how you think and make decisions. 



Logistics

• Type: Part-time, hourly, remote (contractor).

• Hours: Approximately 10 hours per week to start, with room to grow.

• Confidentiality: A signed NDA is required before access to any internal systems or materials.



If this sounds like you, complete the accompanying gig and send it over with your application. We want to see how you think.

title: WallBuddy — Product Video Creator (Amazon + Etsy Wall Art)
description:
**About us**

WallBuddy is an established wall-art brand — 11+ years on Etsy, 80,000+ sales — selling premium posters and framed prints across Amazon (US/CA/UK/DE/FR) and Etsy. We're building a library of short product videos for our best-selling listings, and we need one reliable, tasteful video creator to lead it.



**The work**

Over an initial 8 weeks you'll produce short product videos (10–15 seconds) for roughly 150 of our best-selling listings — about 15-20 per week. These are clean, motion-graphics-style videos built from our existing high-res product mockups: tasteful camera moves, set-assembly reveals, scale shots, and restrained typography. Gallery-quality, not flashy.



You'll work from a style guide we provide, alongside our PPC manager, with everything optimised for conversion on Amazon and Etsy.



**Who we're looking for**

We sell calm, premium, design-led wall art — vintage travel posters, film-aesthetic city prints, blueprint and natural-history series. We need someone whose taste matches that: restraint, good pacing, clean type, nothing cluttered.



The skill that matters most is motion design and visual taste, not generative AI. You should be strong in After Effects / Premiere / CapCut and able to turn a set of still mockups into something that moves beautifully. AI tools (Runway, Veo, and similar) are welcome as a supporting element — but we are not looking for generative-AI showreels full of morphing, uncanny motion. That look is the opposite of our brand and will not get you shortlisted.



**Requirements**

A portfolio showing restrained, professional motion/edit work (not generic AI montages)

Strong motion-graphics ability (After Effects / Premiere / CapCut)

Reliable, consistent turnaround (~15-20 short videos per week)

Fluent written English

40 hrs/week availability





**Mandatory test (required to apply)**

Make one 6–12 second product video for this listing:


 



Constraints — please follow all of them:

Use the mockups from the listing (you may download them directly)

Square, 1080×1080, silent (the platform strips audio), designed to loop seamlessly

Maximum two short text overlays

No generative-AI transitions or morphing effects — show us restraint and pacing



Then write 2–3 sentences explaining your pacing and editing choices.



Upload as an unlisted YouTube link, Google Drive, or Loom. Applications without the test video will not be reviewed — this is how we filter.



**To apply**

Send a message with:



Link to your test video (required)

Portfolio of past work

The tools you use

2–3 sentences on your workflow and where your editing is strongest

Confirmation you're available 40 hrs/week

title: Healthcare Billing Specialist
description:
ABOUT SENIORVERSE:

Seniorverse is a U.S.-based software company focused on senior care. Our modern, all-in-one platform helps adult day centers replace slow, manual processes with a secure and easy-to-use system — covering attendance tracking, care management, compliance reporting, and billing all in one place. Our mission is simple: give adult day centers more time for what matters most — the people they serve.



We are looking for a skilled Billing Specialist to play a key role in our client success process. You will help ensure that our client centers are set up correctly inside the Seniorverse platform and ready to submit accurate claims through Stedii (a U.S. medical billing clearinghouse) — so their billing runs smoothly from the very start.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Billing Specialist is a key member of the Seniorverse customer success and operations ecosystem. You will be responsible for configuring billing within the Seniorverse platform and setting up adult day center customers within Stedii for accurate, timely claims submission. You'll serve as the internal expert on payer requirements — including Medicaid single-payor states, Managed Care Organizations (MCOs), and private pay — and will be the go-to resource for navigating billing codes and resolving claim rejections.



This role is equal parts technical configuration, payer expertise, and client support. The right candidate is someone who can translate complex billing requirements into clean platform setups and who takes pride in keeping revenue flowing smoothly for the centers we serve.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1) Payer & Billing Expertise

• Apply in-depth knowledge of Medicaid billing requirements across single-payor states, including state-specific authorization workflows, Eligibility Verification Systems (EVS), and submission timelines relevant to adult day services

• Navigate MCO billing protocols and contract requirements, ensuring client setups are tailored to each plan

• Process and support private pay billing, including invoicing workflows and client account management

• Maintain current knowledge of applicable billing codes (HCPCS, CPT, ICD-10) and how they apply in adult day center and community-based services settings

• Monitor and communicate payer policy updates that may affect platform configuration or client reimbursement



2) Platform Configuration & Customer Setup

• Configure billing settings within Seniorverse for new and existing adult day center customers, ensuring accurate alignment with each client's payer mix, service types, and authorization parameters

• Set up customer accounts within Stedii for claims submission, including payer enrollment, service code mapping, and authorization entry

• Validate billing configurations prior to go-live to ensure clean first-pass claim submissions

• Maintain and update billing configurations as payer requirements or client contracts change



3) Claims Submission & Revenue Cycle Support:

• Oversee and support the claims submission process across Medicaid (single-payor states), MCOs, and private pay on behalf of client centers

• Monitor claim status through adjudication and payment posting, identifying patterns that indicate configuration or process gaps

• Analyze, correct, and resubmit rejected or denied claims in a timely manner, documenting root causes and implementing corrective measures

• Track and report on claim rejection rates and resolution timelines, surfacing trends to the product and operations teams



4) Client & Internal Collaboration:

• Partner closely with Seniorverse's onboarding, customer success, and product teams to ensure billing configuration is seamlessly integrated into the client launch process

• Serve as a knowledgeable, responsive point of contact for client centers navigating billing questions, rejections, or payer disputes

• Contribute feedback to the product team on billing-related platform improvements based on real-world client needs

• Support internal training efforts by documenting billing workflows, payer nuances, and configuration best practices



QUALIFICATIONS:

1) Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in healthcare billing with direct experience across Medicaid (single-payor states), MCOs, and private pay

• Demonstrated experience configuring billing within healthcare or human services software platforms

• Proficiency with Stedii or comparable clearinghouse/claims management platforms

• Strong working knowledge of billing codes (HCPCS, CPT, ICD-10) as applied in adult day, home care, or community-based services

• Proven track record of managing claim rejections and denials — including analysis, correction, and resubmission — with measurable outcomes

• Proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex billing concepts clearly to non-billing audiences

• Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple client configurations simultaneously

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, tech-forward environment



2) Preferred Qualifications:

• Direct experience with billing management platforms

• Familiarity with Medicaid, MLTC plans, and/or adult daycare (ADC) billing

• Experience supporting SaaS platform customers in a billing configuration or implementation capacity

• Knowledge of EVS processes and prior authorization workflows

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Health Information Management, Business Administration, or a related field



WHY SENIORVERSE:

• Be part of a mission-driven team improving operations for adult day centers across the country

• Work at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and real human impact

• Collaborative, supportive team culture with room to grow

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• Flexible work environment



HOW TO APPLY:

• Send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line "Adult Day Billing Specialist"

• In your message, include:

1) A brief explanation of why this role is a good fit for your skills and experience

2) One specific example of billing work you have done previously (what you billed, what system or process you used, and the outcome)

3) Your familiarity with the U.S. senior care industry or related healthcare experience

4) A copy of your resume

5) Confirmation that you are available to work *Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time (ET)*



We review applications on a rolling basis and will be in touch promptly.



Seniorverse is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

We offer flexibility in the role, but if you are looking for a work-from-home role where you can go missing for parts of the day unannounced or work an additional job during your work hours, this role is not for you. 





The Problem Your Role Is Solving for Our Business





Inconsistent pipeline of qualified contacts 

Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) running out of contacts, slowing down outbound activity and reducing the number of dials.

Low contact buffer levels, creating risk that outbound campaigns pause or lose 
ntum when lists are depleted.

Time lost by SDRs asking for verified contact information, reducing the time they should spend on actual dialling.

Inconsistent quality of contact data, leading to wrong numbers, inaccurate titles, or contacts that do not match the target customer profile.

Expectations of the Role





Own the process of sourcing qualified contacts from platforms such as ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, and other lead databases, ensuring they match our target customer profile.

Verify and validate contact information (phone & mobile numbers,
s, job titles, companies) to maintain a high-quality outbound database.

Maintain a consistent pipeline of contacts so SDRs always have enough leads to dial daily.

Monitor contact buffer levels and proactively source additional leads to prevent cold call campaigns from slowing down.

Support the outbound team’s LinkedIn engagement strategy

Maintain organized and accurate records of sourced contacts in spreadsheets or CRM systems.

Continuously improve lead sourcing efficiency by identifying better filters, search strategies, and data verification methods.

Build strong relationships with the QCS team

Respond promptly to internal communications.

Exemplify our core values and culture.





Responsibilities





Source 800-1,000 Aus, NZ, UK & Ireland qualified cold call contacts per week using platforms such as ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, and other lead databases.

Verify and validate contact details including phone numbers, mobile numbers,
s, job titles, and company information to ensure high data accuracy.

Build and maintain outbound contact lists in spreadsheets

Ensure SDRs always have sufficient contact lists, maintaining a healthy buffer of prospects to support continuous cold call activity.

Regularly monitor contact inventory levels and proactively source new prospects when buffers begin to run low.

Apply proper filtering and research techniques to ensure contacts match the company’s ideal customer profile (industry, company size, role, etc.).

Support LinkedIn outbound and inbound engagement.

Collaborate with the outbound and marketing teams through Slack, HubSpot, and shared spreadsheets) to report sourcing progress and meet daily/weekly targets.

Identify process improvements and propose solutions.

Study potential AI and lead generation tools and help leaders make a decision.

Attend tea
etings and report to the Marketing Head

Work independently and manage time effectively.





Success in this Role Looks Like





SDRs always have a steady stream of verified, high-quality contacts

Cold call contact buffers are consistently maintained.

Lead data is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with our ideal customer profile

Outbound LinkedIn campaigns achieve higher engagement rates

Sourcing processes are efficient, repeatable, and scalable, allowing campaigns to grow without bottlenecks.

Proactive communication and collaboration with the outbound and marketing teams, reporting progress and challenges clearly.

Continual improvement mindset, identifying better sourcing methods, tools, and verification processes to optimize results.

Demonstrates accountability, reliability, and professionalism, embodying our core values and approach to teamwork.

Adaptable and receptive to new tools, strategies, and automation, helping the team leverage innovation for faster and more effective outreach.

Take a proactive approach.

Respond promptly to internal communications.

Follow our Work from Home Policy.









At Quantum, everyone is expected to embody our CORE VALUES and CULTURE as listed below:





Core values

We are always improving Quantum

We are radically transparent and honest

We always over-deliver

We act with courage

We take radical ownership





Culture

We like mistakes. Mistakes mean we improve.

We blame the process, not the person.

We don’t lie or dodge issues that we know are our mistakes. We take ownership & quickly fix what went wrong in the process.

We take radical ownership of our role in the business and everything below it. (Think “it's always my responsibility”)

title: Building Envelope CAD Drafter
description:
Location: Remote

Projects: New York City Metropolitan Area



About Us

We are a building envelope consulting and engineering practice based in the New York City Metropolitan area, specializing in facade inspection, restoration, and repair projects. Our work includes facade assessments, FISP (Local Law 11) compliance, restoration design, waterproofing, masonry repair, and building envelope rehabilitation for a wide range of existing buildings.



Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Building Envelope CAD Drafter to support facade inspection and restoration projects. The ideal candidate will have strong AutoCAD skills, experience producing coordinated construction document sets, and a solid understanding of building envelope systems and facade repair work. 



This role requires someone who can independently develop existing-condition drawings, prepare repair documents, and contribute to the technical accuracy and quality of project deliverables.



Responsibilities



- Prepare construction drawings and repair documents in AutoCAD for facade restoration and building envelope projects.

- Develop accurate exterior building elevations using publicly available resources, photographs, online mapping tools, and reference materials.

- Create and maintain coordinated drawing sets using external references (Xrefs). 

- Apply company CAD standards, templates, line weights, layers, and plotting conventions.

- Draft repair details, notes, schedules, and documentation for facade restoration projects.

- Interpret field observations, condition surveys, and engineering markups.

- Identify appropriate repair approaches for common facade and building envelope deficiencies.

- Coordinate drawings across multiple disciplines and project phases.

- Revise and update drawing sets based on review comments and project requirements.

- Maintain organized project files and CAD standards throughout project execution.



Qualifications



Required

- Proficiency in AutoCAD.

- Experience preparing architectural, facade restoration, or building envelope construction documents.

- Strong understanding of Xrefs, layer management, plotting, templates, and drawing organization.

- Ability to produce existing-condition elevations from available reference information.

- Familiarity with masonry restoration, facade repairs, waterproofing, and exterior wall systems.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision.

- Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality drawings.



Preferred

- Experience with New York City facade restoration projects.

- Familiarity with FISP (Facade Inspection Safety Program / Local Law 11).

- Knowledge of building science and building envelope performance.

- Experience in facade consulting, restoration design, or building envelope engineering.

- Understanding of common NYC building types and construction methods.



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate understands not only how to draft, but also why repairs are being designed. You should be comfortable reviewing existing conditions, understanding repair intent, and translating engineering concepts into clear and coordinated construction documents.



Application Requirements



Please submit:

1. Resume

2. Portfolio or work samples

3. Representative drawing sets demonstrating facade restoration, building envelope, or architectural drafting experience

4. Brief description of your role on each submitted project



Send to 
 with Subject Line: "Building Envelope CAD Drafter - Your Name"

title: Inventory & Demand Planning Systems Specialist - Peak Chocolate
description:
We are Peak Chocolate, an Australian eCommerce brand selling across Amazon Australia, Shopify, and Instagram. We're looking for a skilled Inventory & Demand Planning Systems Specialist to build a demand planning and stock tracking system from scratch — a short project of 2 to 4 weeks that we can run ourselves after handover.



ABOUT THE PROJECT:

We currently manage 30–100 SKUs across our sales channels (Amazon AU via 3PL, Shopify via 3PL, and Instagram). Our biggest pain points are stockouts and over-ordering. We need a clean, functional system — primarily Google Sheets-based — that gives us full visibility and control.



WHAT YOU'LL BUILD:

- A Google Sheets inventory tracker covering all SKUs across Amazon AU, Shopify, and Instagram

- Demand forecasting logic based on sales velocity and lead times

- Reorder triggers and low-stock alerts (automated where possible)

- A simple dashboard our team can use to manage stock levels day-to-day

- Clear documentation so our internal team can manage the system after handover



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Proven experience in demand planning or inventory management for an eCommerce or FMCG brand

- Strong Google Sheets skills — formulas, automation, and reorder triggers

- Experience managing multiple SKUs across retail and online channels

- Understanding of lead times, 3PL operations, and co-manufacturer workflows

- Must have BUILT a system from scratch — not just maintained someone else's



PREFERRED:

- Experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or Shopify

- Familiarity with food/FMCG products



TO APPLY:

Please include a sample dashboard, screenshot, or link to a system you have previously built. Applications without proof of work will not be considered.



Answer these screening questions in your application:

1. Have you built an inventory or demand planning system from scratch before? Describe it briefly.

2. What Google Sheets formulas or automations have you used for reorder triggers?

3. How would you approach building a stock tracking system for a brand selling across 3 channels with a 3PL?



Project duration: 2–4 weeks

Hours: Approx. 3-4 hours/day

Think 3M. Think Grainger. Think Uline. That is the visual register we work in: B2B industrial, utilitarian, spec-driven, durable-looking, function-first. Clean typography, technical illustration, performance claims front and center. This is not consumer retail — it is industrial supply.

That said, the design sensibility must be contemporary, not dated. We want modern industrial — the way the best B2B brands look today, not how a 1990s parts catalog looked. Visuals should feel current and relevant to today's working professionals — millennials and Gen X buyers in their 30s through 50s who are the actual decision-makers in industrial purchasing.

This is not a role for designers whose strongest work is lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wedding, or consumer-brand aesthetics. If your portfolio is built around pastels, soft-lifestyle photography, or "girly" branding, this is not your fit.

The right candidate is equally comfortable producing an enhanced content banner for an e-commerce listing and laying out a print-ready box label with regulatory text, lot numbers, and barcode placement.



2. Scope of Work

The designer will produce visual assets including:

Enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery (product detail page modules, brand store imagery, hero banners)

Website images and banners

Product labels and box label design (print-ready, with regulatory and barcode placement)

Box and packaging design

Infographics for product features, specifications, and application guides

Flyers, brochures, and sell sheets (digital and print)

Safety Data Sheet (SDS) formatting and layout support

Other ad-hoc graphic design work as needed



3. Required Skills & Experience

Proven portfolio of industrial, B2B, MRO, hardware, or technical product design — please include examples

Fluent in English — speaking, listening, and writing. You must be able to communicate effectively with us in real time, understand verbal direction clearly, and respond promptly in writing. This is non-negotiable.

A real creative streak and a contemporary design sensibility. Your work should look current and modern — industrial, but not dated. We need someone who brings ideas to the table, not someone who only applies templates. Designs must resonate with today's working-age buyers (roughly 30s through 50s), not feel like a relic from a previous generation.

Fluent with enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery requirements across major marketplaces (module structures, image specs, dimensions, file formats)

Experience designing print-ready files (labels, packaging, brochures) with attention to bleed, color profiles, and dieline accuracy

Strong typography and layout skills for dense, information-heavy content (specs, instructions, regulatory text)

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) or equivalent professional tools

Ability to follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across assets



To apply, please send over your resume and portfolio.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Accountant — QuickBooks Online (US Company)
description:
We're a US-based commercial facilities and cleaning services company in the Los Angeles area looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed bookkeeper to own our day-to-day accounting in QuickBooks Online and support a documented monthly close. This is a LONG-TERM role — we want someone reliable for years, not a short gig.



You'll work primarily in QuickBooks Online (our system of record for expenses). You'll also be trained on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, where our customer invoicing lives. You do NOT need prior Business Central experience — if you're strong in QuickBooks and truly understand accounting, we will train you. What matters is that you understand double-entry and accrual accounting, not just data entry.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Categorize and reconcile bank and credit card transactions in QuickBooks Online

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Book monthly recurring journal entries and accruals (prepaids, monthly fee accruals) from a documented checklist

- Run a documented monthly close: export journals/trial balance from QuickBooks and enter them into Business Central via Excel

Remote

Closed patients sourced



Long-term role with growth potential.



How to Apply



To apply, you must complete the screening test below.

Applications without completed answers will not be reviewed.







SCREENING TEST (MANDATORY)



Instructions:

Answer all questions clearly and honestly. There are no trick questions. We are testing judgment, clarity, and discipline.

Creative needs with conversion goals

Monitor behavior signals (CTR, CVR, returns, reviews) and iterate



KPI 3: Brand Health & Customer Trust

Objective: Improve brand reputation and customer experience

Metrics:

Review rating + review velocity

Return rate trends and top return reasons

Q&A hygiene and listing clarity improvements

Actions:

Review monitoring + recurring issue reporting

Coordinate content updates to address objections/returns

Strengthen product education via visuals + A+ modules

Qualifications & Skills



Required

3+ years managing private label brands on Amazon (account management / listing optimization

Deep understanding of Amazon SEO and algorithm fundamentals

Strong experience with Helium 10, keyword research, and listing optimization

Proven ability to brief and coordinate creatives (designers, copywriters, photographers)

Familiarity with A+ content, storefront management, and conversion tracking

Strong operational discipline: can manage tasks, trackers, and deadlines without hand-holding



Preferred

Background in marketing, branding, or e-commerce growth strategy

Experience with CRO/testing platforms (e.g., ManageByStats, Splitly, Amazon Experiments)

Experience using Asana, Notion, or Trello for project management

Understanding of PPC’s relationship to CTR/CVR and organic rank (coordination-level, not necessarily hands-on media buying)



Soft Skills

Ownership mentality and high attention to detail

Strong marketing instincts and customer-centric thinking

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Organized, proactive, and reliable

Analytical mindset — able to turn data into decisions



What We Offer

Competitive rates

Fully remote

Bi-weekly payments and performance reviews

Long-term role with growth potential

Paid leave and additional benefits after 6 months (SSS, Pag-ibig, health insurance)

Supportive team culture with room for innovation and contribution

Training resources and personal development opportunities



How to Apply

Include in subject line: “[Your Favorite Book] - Amazon Account / Brand Manager Application”

Attach your updated resume

Include a short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and describing your:

Experience optimizing Amazon listings and improving conversion rates

Tools you’ve used and how you used them

A specific listing improvement you made and the result (CTR/CVR/rank/reviews)

Complete the internet speed test from speedtest.net and attach a screenshot

title: Executive Assistant to the COO
description:
What We Offer

- Starting salary of $1,300+/month USD, with room to grow based on demonstrated experience and judgment

- Direct working relationship with the COO of a fast-scaling creator agency; you'll see how senior decisions actually get made

- A role where you're trusted, not micromanaged, trained early, then given your lane to run

- Daily exposure to AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) used at a professional level

- 100% remote, Philippines-based, full-time (8 hrs/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours

- A genuine career-defining seat for an experienced EA, close to the executive table, broad exposure across the business



The Role

Be the Second Brain to a Senior Executive at a Fast-Growing Creator Agency | $1,300+/month | 100% Remote, Philippines. 



The COO of this agency is at capacity. He's currently doing all of it himself -- updating trackers, chasing people, drafting documents, building workflows, managing calendar conflicts, thinking through hard conversations alone. Every hour spent on that is an hour not spent on the work only a COO can do. This is the role that fixes that.



We're hiring an Executive Assistant who can absorb the COO's recurring admin and execution load, at high volume, at speed, and to a standard he can trust without checking. You'll own the doing so he can own the d
. This is not a hand-holding role. You'll be trained early, then trusted to run your lane.



The right person for this seat doesn't wait to be told the next step. They take the brief and run. They see the work that needs doing before being asked. And they're the kind of operator a COO can hand something off to and consider it handled.





What You'll Own

- Project and tracker management. Keep all the COO's project trackers and statuses current in Airtable. Maintain visibility on what's moving, what's stuck, and what's due. Nothing falls through.

- Follow-ups and chasing. Own the follow-up loop end-to-end. Chase outstanding items, send the reminders, surface blockers to the COO before they become problems.

- Document drafting. Draft documents the COO would otherwise write himself; to a standard he can route straight for approval without rewriting.

- Workflow builds in ProcessStreet. Build straightforward, repeatable workflows so the COO doesn't have to. Examples: one-off task workflows, leave handoff workflows where leave isn't approved until a handoff plan is filled out and routed.

- Process builds for capacity-constrained department heads. When a department head is buried, build their process for them under the COO's direction. Example: standing up a hiring or onboarding workflow when the owner is buried in interviews.

- Calendar and scheduling. Manage the COO's calendar, resolve meeting overlaps, find times that work across multiple people's schedules.

- Thinking partner. Act as a sounding board on draining or tricky calls. Offer a different angle on how to approach a hard conversation. Handle the legwork of putting things into Claude for the COO.





What You Bring:

Experience (non-negotiable)

- Prior experience as an EA to a senior executive. We want someone who already understands the cadence of supporting an exec at this level; not someone learning it for the first time.

- Comfortable operating at pace across many small parallel tasks. This role is high-volume throughput, not deep specialist work.

Skills (must-have)

- Project and tracker management, hands-on with Airtable

- Strong follow-up discipline; you don't need to be told twice

- Document drafting to a standard a senior executive can route without edits

- ProcessStreet workflow building from a brief

- Calendar management across multiple people's schedules

- Proficient in Claude and AI tools as part of your daily workflow

- Native English



Personality and culture fit (non-negotiable)

- Self-starter. Takes the brief and runs.

- A useful second brain: Offers a different perspective on how to approach a tricky conversation, not just executes the task

- Discreet and trustworthy. You'll see contracts, compensation conversations, and sensitive internal decisions

- Reliable enough that the COO can hand something off and consider it done





Location & Hours

100% remote, based in the Philippines. 

Full-time (8 hours/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours.



How You'll Be Measured

- This role is measured on how much load it reliably takes off the COO and how cleanly the work gets done. Specific KPIs and targets are set quarterly with the COO, but the core measures are:

- Task turnaround — speed and reliability on items the COO hands off

- Tracker accuracy and freshness — project trackers stay current, accurate, and trusted as a single source of truth

- Follow-up completion — outstanding items chased to closure, blockers surfaced early

- COO time reclaimed — the headline outcome. How much of the COO's week is freed from admin back into strategic work.



Hiring Process

Application ? screening call with the People team ? working interview with the COO ? final decision. We move quickly: strong candidates typically receive offers within 10 days of first contact.

title: Senior Sales & Business Development Manager — Outbound Acquisition Expert | High Uncapped Commission
description:
Acendia International is a US?registered company based in Delaware, built to become the next major global leader in local lead generation and digital growth. We are creating an AI?Native Agency — built from the ground up using the best artificial intelligence tools to work faster, deliver better results, and stay years ahead of every competitor.

We specialise in helping trade and service businesses dominate their markets, attract high?value clients, and scale without limits.

We are already a fully operational, revenue?generating business. We have proven systems that deliver consistent results, and a rapidly growing client base. Our roadmap is clear: expand rapidly, build a team of experts, and become the undisputed market leader — powered by AI.

This is your opportunity to be our SECOND core hire — our Senior Sales & Business Development Manager. You will not just close deals; you will build our sales engine, shape how we grow, and grow alongside us as we expand. You start remote, with a clear path to work from our brand?new office in Global City, Metro Manila as we open it.

This is not just a job — it is a career opportunity for a seasoned outbound sales professional who lives and breathes closing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

As our dedicated sales leader, you own the entire revenue side of the business. You are the voice of Acendia, the person who brings new partners on board, and the driver of our growth. You are an expert in outbound sales & acquisition, you love the chase, and you thrive on closing deals. You will use AI tools to work smarter, research better, and close faster — turning leads into long?term, high?value clients.

1. FULL OUTBOUND SALES CYCLE (YOUR CORE EXPERTISE)



Own every stage: prospecting ? cold outreach ? qualification ? presentation ? negotiation ? close ? onboarding

Leverage your 5+ years of outbound sales & acquisition experience to build pipelines from scratch and consistently open new business

Use our proven pitch and presentation framework — we give you everything you need to win, but you bring the skill and drive to make it happen

Deliver clear, confident presentations and proposals — explain exactly how we help businesses grow and generate more leads

Close new clients consistently — you are passionate about closing, and every deal you sign is a win you are proud of

Manage your own pipeline, track every opportunity, and report on progress — you run your own desk like a business owner

Build long?term relationships — we don’t do one?off sales; we build partnerships that last for years



2. LEAD GENERATION & OUTREACH — AI?POWERED



Identify and target high?potential trade and service businesses — you know how to find, research, and approach decision?makers effectively

Leverage AI tools (Claude, etc.) to research businesses, understand their needs, and craft personalised messages that get replies — combining your sales skill with modern tech

Conduct outreach via phone,
, and messaging — you are comfortable picking up the phone, speaking to business owners, and leading the conversation

Follow up consistently and professionally — you know that persistence wins deals, and you never let a lead slip away

Qualify every prospect to ensure they are a good fit — you know exactly who we can help and who we cannot



3. NEGOTIATION, CLOSING & RETENTION



Present our pricing and packages with confidence — you know the value we deliver and you stand by it

Handle objections professionally and effectively — you have done this for years; you turn “no” or “maybe” into “yes” naturally

Negotiate terms that work for both sides — while protecting our margins and standards

Ensure smooth handover to our delivery team — you set clear expectations so clients stay happy and renew

Help us refine our offers, pricing, and sales process — your feedback from the market is gold to us



4. GROWTH & PROCESS IMPROVEMENT — BUILDING OUR SALES SYSTEMS



Help us build our AI?powered sales workflows — show us how to use tools to automate outreach, personalise faster, and close more

Create scripts, templates, and processes that will be used as we expand and grow — drawing on your years of professional experience

Work directly with the founder to set growth targets and strategy

As we expand, high performers will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility, lead projects, and advance their career based entirely on results and delivery — performance = progression





WHO YOU ARE



5+ YEARS PROVEN OUTBOUND SALES & ACQUISITION EXPERIENCE — NON?NEGOTIABLE

You are passionate about closing deals: This isn’t just work for you — you love the process, you love the win, and you are driven by results

You are AI?fluent & proficient: You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants every day to research, write, plan, and sell — you know how to use AI to work faster and smarter than any other salesperson

You are a natural, seasoned closer: Confident, persuasive, resilient, and disciplined — you know exactly how to move a prospect from interest to signed contract

You have a strong track record: Ideally in digital marketing, lead generation, advertising, or B2B services — you know how to sell value, not just price

You understand services: You get how digital marketing and lead generation helps businesses make money — you can explain it simply to anyone

You are excellent on the phone: Clear, friendly, professional, and authoritative — you sound like a trusted partner, not a pushy salesperson

You are results obsessed: You don’t care about hours worked — you care about deals signed and revenue generated

You work independently, fast, and reliably — you take ownership, you manage your own time, and you deliver without supervision

You speak and write perfect, fluent English — this is non?negotiable; you will speak to business owners daily

You are ambitious: You want to grow, perform at a high level, and build something big — you want to be part of building a new?generation AI agency

Bonus: Experience selling to trade, construction, or service businesses is a huge advantage





WHAT WE OFFER



Base Salary: US$1,150 / month — stable, paid on time, every month

Commission: Generous, uncapped commission paid on every deal you close + renewal bonuses — top performers earn US$2,000–$2,500+ total per month easily

Clear Expectations: We reward performance and results — the more you deliver, the more you earn and grow

Career Progression: Real opportunities to advance based strictly on what you achieve — no empty promises, just results?based growth

World?Class Office: Start 100% remote ? move to our modern, purpose?built office in Global City, Metro Manila

High?Performance Culture: We move fast, we win, we reward excellence. No bureaucracy, no red tape — just results and growth

Full Support: We give you our pitch decks, presentation materials, and everything you need to succeed — you bring the experience and passion

Long?Term Security: We are a profitable, growing US?based business with a clear expansion plan — you build your future with us





HOW TO APPLY

Send your application with:



Your CV / Resume — clearly highlighting your 5+ years outbound sales & acquisition experience

Sales Track Record: Tell us exactly what you have sold, to whom, and your results — we want to hear about your biggest wins, your closing ratios, and how you consistently hit targets

Short note on how you use AI: Tell us which tools you use (Claude, etc.) and exactly how you use them to help you sell more and work faster

90?SECOND INTRO VIDEO: Record a short video telling us:

Who you are

Your years of outbound experience and your proudest closing achievement

How you use AI in your work

Why you are passionate about closing deals and why you want to build our sales engine(Phone recording is fine — just clear audio & video, be yourself)





A short statement: “I have 5+ years in outbound sales & acquisition, I am passionate about closing deals, I am AI?proficient, and I want to help build Acendia International as a leading AI?Native Agency.”



We are hiring immediately. Only apply if you are a seasoned outbound professional, love closing, and are ready to deliver results at the highest level.

title: UI/UX Designer (Figma)
description:
UI/UX Designer (Figma)

Part-time | Remote | ~20 hours/week | Long-term engagement



About Us

We are a mobile app development and fractional CTO consultancy that works with startups and growing businesses to build products that are technically solid and genuinely well-designed. We partner closely with our clients across the full product lifecycle, from strategy and design through to development and launch.

We are growing our team and looking for a UI/UX designer who can work across multiple client projects with us on an ongoing basis.



The Role

We need a UI/UX designer to own Figma design work across our client projects, primarily focused on iOS mobile apps. You will work closely with our project managers, engineers, and clients to translate product ideas into clean, buildable designs that follow Apple's Human Interface Guidelines.

This is not a "make it pretty" role. This is a "make it work, make it make sense, and make sure we're building the right thing" role.



What You Will Actually Be Doing

- Owning and maintaining Figma design systems across client projects (component libraries, color tokens, typography, spacing, corner radii)

- Designing and iterating on iOS app screens across full user journeys

- Translating product ideas into wireframes and high-fidelity mockups

- Working within Apple's UI guidelines and using standard iOS components and libraries

- Attending regular check-ins with our internal team and client stakeholders

- Flagging when a design direction won't work technically or won't make sense to users

- Helping the team prioritize which ideas are worth designing now vs. later



What We Are Looking For

On the technical side:

- Strong Figma skills including component libraries, auto layout, and design tokens

- Solid understanding of iOS design patterns and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines

- Experience designing mobile apps, not just websites

- Ability to hand off clean, organized files that an engineer can actually build from

- Familiarity with design systems and how global changes (theming, sizing) work in Figma

- On the personality side, this is equally important:

- You are direct. If an idea won't work, you say so clearly and explain why.

- You are proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You see a gap and you fill it.

- You are confident enough to push back. Our clients are passionate and move fast. We need someone who can channel that energy into good design decisions, not just execute everything thrown at them.

- You can tell the difference between a good idea that needs refining and an idea that needs to be set aside for now.

- You communicate clearly in writing. Most of our collaboration happens async.



What This Is Not

This is not a role for someone who just does what they are told

This is not a role for someone who needs everything figured out before they can start

This is not a role for someone who treats every client idea as equally worth designing



Nice to Have

Experience working directly with non-technical clients or founders in a startup environment

Familiarity with health, wellness, or lifestyle apps

Experience designing for accessibility (contrast, font sizing, Apple accessibility standards)



Logistics

Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week to start

Long-term engagement if it's a good fit

Payment in USD



How to Apply

Please send the following:

Your portfolio (Figma files preferred, not just screenshots)

A brief note (3-5 sentences) on how you handle it when a client asks you to design something you think is a bad idea

Your availability and rate

We read every application. We will not respond to applications without a portfolio.

[Full-Time] [Remote] [Competitive Salary] [US Market]

About Goda



We are Goda, a fast-growing DTC brand in the fragrance and skincare space, selling across the US and globally. Our hero products have built a loyal customer base, and we're scaling fast.



We run paid social at high volume, bringing in new customers every day. Our Customer Success team plays a critical role in turning first-time buyers into long-term customers by proactively reaching out, building trust, addressing concerns, and creating positive customer experiences that drive retention.



This is not a traditional customer support role. We don't wait for customers to contact us — we proactively reach out to ensure they succeed with our products and remain engaged with our brand.



The Role



You'll be responsible for making outbound calls to customers across the US market. Your primary goal is to strengthen customer relationships, improve retention, reduce subscription churn, gather feedback, and ensure customers are getting the most value from their experience with Goda.



You'll work closely with our Customer Success and Operations teams, follow established workflows, and maintain detailed records of customer interactions within our systems.



You'll report directly to the Customer Success Manager and be measured against activity, quality, and retention-focused KPIs. We expect you to take ownership, identify customer trends, and surface opportunities that help improve both the customer experience and business performance.



What You'll Be Doing

Outbound Customer Engagement

• Making outbound calls to customers throughout the day to provide support, answer questions, and strengthen customer relationships

• Conducting proactive follow-ups with new customers to ensure a positive experience with their purchase

• Reaching out to subscription customers regarding upcoming renewals, account concerns, and retention opportunities

• Handling customer objections professionally and helping customers find solutions that fit their needs

• Gathering customer feedback and identifying recurring themes, concerns, or opportunities

• Maintaining accurate records of customer interactions, outcomes, and follow-up actions

• Building rapport with customers while representing the brand in a professional and customer-centric manner



Retention & Customer Success

• Identifying customers at risk of cancellation and proactively addressing concerns

• Supporting customer retention initiatives through personalized conversations and relationship-building

• Helping customers understand product benefits, subscription options, and available solutions

• Escalating complex customer concerns through the appropriate internal channels when necessary

• Working closely with leadership to surface customer insights that may improve retention and customer experience



Quality & Accountability

• Meeting daily outbound call targets and productivity expectations

• Maintaining high-quality conversations and customer satisfaction standards

• Following established processes while applying sound judgment when handling unique situations

• Contributing ideas that improve customer experience, call workflows, and team processes

• Taking ownership of customer outcomes rather than simply completing activities



What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

• Prior outbound calling experience in a call center, sales, customer success, retention, or similar phone-based environment

• Comfortable handling high call volumes (40–50 outbound calls per day)

• Excellent spoken English with a neutral or American-accented communication style

• Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly over the phone

• Failure to document customer interactions accurately

• Inability to handle rejection or maintain professionalism during challenging conversations

• Waiting to be told what to do instead of proactively taking action



How We Measure Your Performance

• Customer retention and subscription save performance

• Quality assurance scores and call reviews

• Customer satisfaction and feedback

• Accuracy of customer records and follow-up completion

• Consistency in meeting team KPIs and operational standards



Compensation & Benefits

title: Long-Form Video Editor — YouTube (Vlog / Talking-Head / Whiteboard)
description:
## Who I Am



I'm Basit Oyebanji. In the last 18 months, I've collected over $2.7M in the online sales space. I run a group mentorship and a 1:1 intensive called The Haven Freedom Protocol — helping athletes and 9-5 workers earn 3-10k+/month online in 90 days or less.



I'm not a guru with a microphone. I walked the path first. Now I coach people through it.



I already have a full team running — SDR, content strategist, strategic advisor, calendar manager, and a creative director handling content systems. This isn't a one-man startup. It's a real operation being scaled intentionally.



---



## Why I'm Hiring You



There's no dedicated long-form editor on the team yet. The YouTube channel is being built properly — and I need someone who actually understands what that means.



This isn't "cut out the silences and add some music." Long-form is storytelling. It's retention. It's the thing that turns a stranger into a believer before they ever book a call.



I need someone who feels the pacing, knows when to hold a 
nt and when to cut, and can make a 15-minute vlog feel like it flew past.



The channel is young. That means whoever comes in now helps build the standard — not inherit someone else's template.



---



## What You'll Edit



- **YouTube vlogs** — travel, training, behind-the-scenes (Cape Town, Barcelona, Miami, Lagos)

- **Talking-head / whiteboard breakdowns** — sales frameworks, mindset, athlete-to-business mapping

- **Podcast-style edits** — guest conversations, long-form interviews

- **Cinematic, natural light, documentary feel** — not glossy ad, not flat studio



---



## What I Need From You



- **You've edited long-form before.** YouTube, documentary, vlog — format doesn't matter as much as proof you can hold pacing across 10–20 minutes without losing people.

- **You communicate cleanly.** If you're going to miss a deadline, you tell me *before* it's missed. Not after.

- **You get the brief without it being repeated five times.** Watch the raw footage. Feel the story. Know what belongs and what doesn't.

- **You take feedback without ego.** The first few videos will have back-and-forth. That's normal. Revision is refinement, not criticism.

- **You're consistent.** Video 10 should be better than video 1 — not a coin flip.



---



## What Success Looks Like



- **30 days** — first batch delivered on time. Revisions minimal. I can trust the process.

- **90 days** — channel has a clear visual identity. Retention trending up. I hand you raw footage and trust it'll come back right.

- **6 months** — you know the brand as well as anyone on the team. Proactively flagging what's working. The channel is compounding.



---



## How To Apply



**? Apply here:** Long-Form Video Editor Application





The form takes 8–10 minutes. Some questions will make you think — that's intentional.



It includes a **sample edit** using my footage + a **short Loom recording** introducing yourself. Both are required.



No templates. No copy-paste answers. I read every application personally.

We are looking for a seasoned operator to run it end to end: sourcing and preparing targeted prospect lists, executing outbound campaigns across both channels, managing prospect responses, and converting them into qualified, booked meetings.



This is a high-ownership execution role for someone who takes pride in disciplined, repeatable outbound and consistently hitting meeting targets. It is not a strategy or funnel-design role — the system already exists, and we are hiring someone to run it exceptionally well.



Responsibilities



Own and execute daily outbound across LinkedIn and

Build and rigorously clean targeted prospect lists aligned to our ideal customer profile.

Launch, monitor, and maintain the health and deliverability of active outbound campaigns.

Manage inbound replies promptly and professionally — qualifying prospects and booking meetings onto the calendar.

Maintain accurate pipeline and CRM hygiene so no opportunity is lost.

Operate within channel best-practice limits to protect long-term deliverability and account standing.





Requirements



2+ years of B2B outbound sales / SDR / BDR experience with a demonstrable record of booking qualified meetings.

Hands-on experience running cold

Excellent written English and a confident, professional communication style.

Strong organisational discipline and attention to detail, particularly with data, lists, and follow-up.

Comfortable working independently from a documented process and self-managing to daily targets.

Proficiency with CRMs, outreach platforms, and spreadsheets.

Experience running multi-channel (LinkedIn +

Background booking meetings for marketing, agency, or professional-services offers.



What we offer



Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission

A remote, autonomous working environment.

A fully built, documented system — you focus on execution and results, not infrastructure.

Record a Loom video of your outbound experience, outlining your entire end to end process including the channels and tools you have worked with and demonstrate results you have delivered. title: B2B Sales Representative
description:
B2B Sales Representative

Remote (global, English-speaking) · Full-time · 3–5 yrs outbound experience



Hears makes premium hearing protection that people actually want to wear. We started because we couldn't find earplugs we'd be caught dead in at a festival, so we spent two years building our own with world-class acoustic engineers and audiologists. The product won an iF Design Award. DJs, producers, and venues trust it. Our B2B side — festivals, clubs, corporates, retail, music industry — has quietly become one of the most exciting parts of the business.



It's also the part with the most upside left to capture. That's why we're hiring.



The role

You're the second pair of boots on the ground for B2B. You'll work directly alongside our B2B Manager, Luuk, and report into the founding team. The job is simple to describe and hard to do well: open new doors, build a pipeline, and close deals.



Your day looks roughly like this:

- Cold outreach. LinkedIn,
 and phone. Real conversations, not blasted templates. You'll be building sequences, testing angles, and getting on calls with people who didn't know they needed us yesterday.

- Owning your pipeline. From first touch to signed deal. You'll qualify,send samples, negotiate and close — with full support from us, but you run the process.

- Representing Hears. You're often the first human contact a prospect has with the brand. How you write, call and follow up sets the tone. We care about this a lot.

- Working five segments: venues & hospitality, festivals & events, corporate wellbeing, pharmacies & retail, and music industry (labels, studios, artist teams). You'll learn fast which ones convert hardest for you and we'll lean in.

- Feeding the machine. Clean CRM hygiene, weekly numbers, honest reporting on what's working and what isn't. We don't need theatre — we need signal.

- Running the admin side. Keeping the CRM tidy, logging every touchpoint, tracking deal stages honestly, sending samples on time, following up when you said you would. Half of B2B sales is just doing what you said you'd do, on time. We need someone who treats that as part of the craft, not a chore.



What we're looking for

- Mid-level. 3–5 years of proven outbound sales experience in B2B. We're not hiring on a script — we're hiring on a track record. If you've consistently hit or beaten quota in an outbound role, we want to talk.



Specifically:

- 3–5 years in B2B sales or business development, with at least two of those running outbound (not just inbound or account management).

- Numbers you can point to. Quota attainment, pipeline generated, deals closed, ACV. We'll ask. Bring receipts.

- Native or near-native English, written and spoken. Additional languages (Dutch, German, Spanish, French) are a strong plus.

- Fluent with the modern sales stack — Notion LinkedIn Sales Navigator,
 sequencing tools, Apollo / Lusha / equivalent. -- You don't need to know our exact tools; you need to be the kind of person who learns them in a week.

- Comfortable on the phone. A lot of this role still happens on calls. If cold calling makes you flinch, this isn't the right fit.

- Self-driven and remote-ready. You'll be working across time zones with a small team. We measure output, not hours — which only works if you're someone who actually runs themselves.

- Bonus points for experience in events, music, hospitality, wellness or premium consumer brands. Genuine personal interest in any of those worlds counts.

- Confident and authentic seller. We don't work with scripts and tacky sales tactics you see on socials these days. People buy from people they trust, and the product does half the selling already.



What you get

- Competitive base + uncapped commission. The more you close, the more you make. Simple.

- A real growth path. This is the second B2B hire. The person who shows up and performs has a clear shot at building and leading a team inside 12–18 months.

- Full remote. Work from wherever you do your best work, as long as you can overlap meaningfully with European hours.

- A product people are actually excited to hear about. Cold outreach is hard. It's a lot less hard when prospects reply with "oh, you guys made these? I love them."

- Direct access to founders. No layers. You'll work closely with Luuk on B2B and have a direct line to us on anything that needs unblocking.



How we work

- Direct, honest, low on corporate theatre. We care about output and we care about the brand. We move fast, we say what we mean, and we expect the same back. If that sounds like your kind of place, you'll like it here.



How to apply

Fill out this Notion Form: 



- Your CV — short and specific is better than long and generic.

- A short note (no cover letter required) telling us: the deal you're most proud of closing, and which of our five segments you'd attack first and why.

- Optional but appreciated: a 60-second Loom of you pitching a product you love. Doesn't have to be ours. We just want to see how you sound.



We read everything. We reply to everyone.



— Nick & Bob

Co-founders, Hears
