title: Social Media & Digital Growth Strategist - Remote - Global Staffing
description:
About Emergetech



At Emergetech, we are transforming the recruitment and digital enablement landscape through a strict commitment to innovation. We don't just post jobs and wait; we proactively map talent ecosystems and headhunt high-quality specialists across Cloud Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Tech, and Marketing for a global clientele.



As the digital landscape evolves, so do we. We are looking for a forward-thinking Social Media & Digital Growth Strategist who can leverage cutting-edge digital marketing, SEO, and AI search to scale our brand visibility, capture client interest, and supercharge our talent pipelines.



The Role



This isn't a traditional content-creation role. We are looking for a hybrid growth marketer who understands the mechanics of the recruitment sector and knows how to build cross-channel acquisition funnels. You will take complete ownership of our LinkedIn strategy to drive B2B engagement, build high-converting Google Ads & Landing Pages, and pioneer our strategy for Generative AI search optimization (GEO) to ensure Emergetech is top-of-mind whenever clients or candidates use AI platforms.



Key Responsibilities



LinkedIn Authority Building: Architect and execute our organic and paid LinkedIn strategy. Author compelling copy and design content frameworks that position Emergetech’s consultants as industry thought leaders.

Next-Gen SEO & AI Search Optimization: Manage traditional SEO keyword strategies while actively optimizing our digital footprint for LLM search engines (like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini) so Emergetech is consistently cited as a top staffing partner.

Google PPC & Landing Page Architecture: Design, launch, and manage Google Paid Search campaigns targeting B2B client decision-makers. Build and continuously A/B test responsive, high-converting landing pages.

Recruitment Funnel Integration: Align social media awareness with search intent to capture inbound client leads (hiring managers) and build pre-vetted talent pools of elite candidates.

Performance Analytics: Monitor conversion metrics, CPA (Cost Per Acquisition), and attribution data to prove clear ROI and scale what works.



What We’re Looking For



Recruitment Industry Background: (Highly Desirable) You have directly handled marketing or growth strategy for a staffing agency, executive search firm, or recruitment consultancy. You intimately understand client acquisition and candidate attraction cycles.

LinkedIn B2B Expertise: A proven portfolio of growing corporate profiles, driving inbound leads, and running targeted LinkedIn campaigns.

Modern Search Savvy: Comprehensive knowledge of on-page/off-page SEO, schema markup, and how Large Language Models (LLMs) crawl and synthesize web data for user queries.

PPC & Conversion Copywriting: Hands-on experience scaling Google Ads budgets and constructing clear, minimalist landing pages using modern CMS or funnel builders.

Tech-Fluent Communication: Ability to communicate easily with tech-minded candidates and executive stakeholders.



Interested? Apply now and please ensure that you attach your CV.

title: VIDEO EDITOR STANDARD — EMOTION & PERSUASION
description:
VIDEO EDITOR STANDARD — EMOTION & PERSUASION



Can be guys from Cinema school 

1?? He understands that the script is NOT the final work

A top-tier editor understands that:

The script = intention

The edit = emotional amplification

His role is not to execute the script literally,

but to amplify it visually by:

proving what the script claims,

reinforcing every message through imagery,

creating emotion where words only suggest it.

The edit must make the viewer feel what the script is saying.

2?? He can create emotion without showing the product

This is non-negotiable.

A strong editor can instinctively make the viewer feel something through editing alone.

He knows how to use:

Faces

Gestures

Situations

Visual silence

Micro-
nts:

eye contact

breathing

discomfort

relief

?? He must be able to create an ad that generates emotion and desire even with no sound and no captions.

If the message only works with text or audio, the edit is not good enough.

3?? He understands that pacing is a persuasion weapon

A top editor uses rhythm as a psychological tool:

1–3 seconds max per shot (often less)

Tempo variations to create tension and release

Intentional pauses to let emotion land

A great edit:

is felt, not noticed

holds attention without the viewer knowing why

never feels “edited”



???? RED FLAGS (INSTANT DISQUALIFIERS)

? Script-execution mindset

“I follow the script exactly”

“I edit what’s written”

Treats the script as the final output

? Needs product shots to create impact

Asks immediately for product footage

Can’t create emotion without showing the product

Relies on features instead of feeling

? Text-dependent editing

The ad only works with captions

Overuses on-screen text to explain

Emotion disappears when muted

? Flat or generic pacing

Long shots with no tension

Same rhythm from start to finish

No sense of buildup or release

? “Pretty but empty” edits

Clean transitions but no emotion

Cinematic for the sake of style

Focused on aesthetics, not persuasion

? Overused, stock-looking visuals

Generic smiling people

Obvious stock footage

No real micro-
nts or human imperfection

? Explains instead of making you feel

Tries to inform before creating emotion

Prioritizes clarity over impact

No visceral reaction from the viewer

???? GOLDEN RULE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

If the ad doesn’t make you feel something

and want to keep watching — and buying —

even on mute, with no captions,

it’s not a good ad.

title: Senior Google Media Buyer with YouTube Ads Experience ($10-$12.5 per hour)
description:
About the Role



We are a fast growing performance marketing agency generating leads across multiple industries. Our Google campaigns are already live and spending. This role is not about building accounts from the ground up. It is about stepping into active campaigns, identifying what is dragging performance down, and fixing it decisively with clear reasoning behind every move.



You will report directly to our Operations Manager and Founders. No layers, no waiting. Your work gets seen and acted on right away.





What You Will Be Doing



>Monitor all active Google Ads campaigns daily with a strong focus on YouTube and keep a close eye on performance trends before they turn into bigger problems.

>Dig into the data to find real CPL improvement opportunities across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, and campaign structure.

>When performance drops, you diagnose it quickly, fix it with intention, and document your reasoning clearly so the team stays aligned.

>Catch creative fatigue before it hurts results and brief new hooks and testing angles backed by what the numbers are telling you.

>Stay on top of what is trending on YouTube and proactively bring fresh ideas to the table. We want someone who notices what is gaining traction on the platform before it shows up in our metrics.

>Come up with new hook concepts and creative angles regularly. You do not need to produce the content yourself, but you should always have suggestions ready and know how to brief the team clearly on what to test next.

>Adjust targeting, audiences, budgets, bid strategies, and campaign structure based on evidence, not gut feel.

>Research what competitors are running on YouTube and translate those insights into creative briefs the content team can act on immediately.

>Send a concise weekly performance report with clear, actionable next steps every single week.

>Stay in close communication with the team through Slack and manage your own tasks in ClickUp without needing to be followed up on.





What We Are Looking For



>At least 3 years of hands on experience managing Google Ads with YouTube as a primary channel in a performance focused, lead generation environment.

>Someone who has a proven track record of improving existing accounts, not just launching them and moving on.

>Deep understanding of how YouTube ad formats work inside Google Ads Manager, including In Stream, In Feed, and Shorts placements, and when to use each one.

>A solid grasp of lead generation funnels and what actually drives CPL down over time.

>Comfortable working inside large scale Google Ads Manager accounts with meaningful daily spend.

>A genuine interest in YouTube as a platform. You should be someone who actively watches trends, pays attention to what is getting views and engagement, and brings that awareness directly into your campaign decisions.

>Strong creative instincts around hooks and angles. You know what stops a scroll and holds attention in the first 5 seconds, and you can explain why something will or will not work before it ever goes live.

>Able to produce clear and actionable creative briefs that a content team can run with straight away, no back and forth needed.

>Proficient with ClickUp and Slack as part of a remote, self managed workflow.

>Strong written communicator who takes ownership and gets things done without being micromanaged.





Logic Question (Required)



You are managing a YouTube lead generation campaign inside Google Ads. Over the past 7 days CPL has increased by 60% even though budget, audience, and creative have not changed. Your In Stream skippable ads are showing a view through rate that has dropped from 40% to 19%. Impression share has remained stable. Landing page conversion rate is holding steady at 13%.



Walk us through your full diagnostic process. What do you check first, in what order, and why? What is your hypothesis and what action do you take?

We are not looking for a perfect answer. We want to see how you think, how you structure a problem, and how deep your knowledge of the platform actually goes.





Video Introduction (Required)



****Record a 2 to 3 minute video and upload it to Loom or Google Drive.**** 

Include the link in your application. Tell us who you are, walk us through your Google and YouTube Ads experience, share a specific result you are proud of with real numbers, and explain why this role makes sense for where you are right now.





Read This Before You Apply



To confirm you have read this post in full, begin your cover letter with the exact phrase "I want to grow lucky". Applications that do not start with this phrase will not be reviewed.





What We Offer



$10-$12.5 per hour based on experience, with a formal review after probation.



A full time remote position with a stable, growing agency that has no plans of slowing down.



Direct access to the Founders and Operations Manager with no middlemen in between.



A fast moving environment where the decisions you make today show up in the numbers tomorrow.





How to Apply



Send in your CV and a cover letter starting with the required phrase, along with your video link. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

title: Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript / React / AWS) — Long-Term, Full-Time
description:
About the role



We're a UK-based ecommerce company building a SaaS web platform that helps online retailers understand and improve their business performance. The product is live and growing, and we're looking for one skilled developer to join us full-time and help take it forward — building new features, improving what's there, and keeping everything running smoothly.



This is a long-term position for someone who wants stability, ownership of their work, and the chance to grow with a product over years, not weeks. You'll work directly with the founder, so clear communication and the ability to work independently matter as much as your code.



  What you'll be doing



  - Building and maintaining features across the full stack (frontend and backend)

  - Working with our API integrations to third-party services and pulling/processing data reliably

  - Writing clean, tested, maintainable TypeScript

  - Helping diagnose and fix bugs, and improving performance

  - Collaborating on what to build next — your ideas are welcome



  You must have solid experience with



  - TypeScript & Node.js (this is non-negotiable — most of our code is TypeScript)

  - React (modern hooks, component-driven UIs)

  - AWS serverless — Lambda, API Gateway, and ideally infrastructure-as-code (CDK or CloudFormation)

  - PostgreSQL / relational databases — schema design, writing efficient queries, migrations

  - REST APIs — both consuming third-party APIs and building your own

  - Git and a disciplined, test-as-you-go working style



  Nice to have (not required)



  - Experience integrating with large external APIs (marketplaces, payment providers, etc.)

  - AWS Step Functions, EventBridge, or other event-driven patterns

  - Stripe integration

  - An eye for clean, usable UI



  What we offer



  - Full-time, long-term, stable role (40 hrs/week)

  - Competitive monthly salary based on your experience

  - Real ownership — you'll see your work used by real customers



 Working hours: Mostly flexible, but you'll need 2–3 hours of overlap with UK business hours (GMT/BST) for calls and collaboration.



  ---

HOW TO APPLY — please read carefully



I get a lot of applications, so I screen hard. To show me you actually read this:



1. Start your message with the word EVERGREEN (applications without this are deleted unread).

2. Briefly tell me about one project where you used TypeScript on AWS — what it did and what your specific role was.

3. Answer this: "You need to fetch data from a third-party API that's slow and sometimes rate-limits you. How would you make that reliable?" (2–3 sentences is fine.)

4. Send a link to your GitHub, portfolio, or any code sample you're proud of.



I'll reply within a few days to anyone who follows all four steps. Looking forward to meeting you.
